name: Taxonomy Menu UI
description: Add ability to create menu links for taxonomy terms.
project_description:

Taxonomy Menu UI allows you to create menu links for taxonomy terms, similar to Drupal’s built-in menu settings for nodes.

 The module adds Menu settings to taxonomy vocabularies, where you can enable menu support and configure the available menus and default parent item. Once enabled, each taxonomy term includes a Menu settings tab that lets you create and manage its menu link.

 This provides the same familiar workflow as node menu settings while keeping menu management directly on the taxonomy term edit form.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Go to Structure → Taxonomy → Edit vocabulary → Menu settings . 
 Enable the desired menus and configure the default parent item. 
 Save the vocabulary. 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Create or edit a taxonomy term. 
 Open the Menu settings tab. 
 Configure the menu link title, parent item, weight, and other menu link settings. 
 Save the taxonomy term.
